Одно утверждение о возможности video-to-image: модель берёт видео (файл или URL YouTube) как мультимодальный реф и создаёт новые картинки по сценам; E-20-65 (ч1) и E-326-58 («другое») — одна фраза кукбука на страницах-копиях.

Один и тот же список MIME-типов входных картинок (png, jpeg, webp, heic, heif) из карточек моделей и гайда Cloud.

Одно утверждение со страницы Gemini 3 (стр. 133) о компромиссе media_resolution: выше — больше деталей, токенов и задержки; ниже — дешевле, и его снижают, чтобы уместить длинные входы.
Одно наблюдение по официальным примерам: рефы в промпте называют по содержанию (указательно или притяжательно) или по позиции, а внешность оставляют картинке.

ядра.ядро_en: Maximum number of input images per request: up to 14 for each Gemini 3.x image model (Gemini 3 Pro Image, Gemini 3.1 Flash Image, Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite Image), which can mix up to 14 reference images to produce the final image, and up to 3 for Gemini 2.5 Flash Image, which works best with up to 3 images as input; each base64-encoded input image may be up to 7 MB.

части.текст_en: Gemini 3.x image models: 'Max number of input images … 14 images' per request; Vertex AI card for Gemini 3 Pro Image: 'Maximum images per prompt: 14'.
Gemini 2.5 Flash Image: up to 3 input images per request ('Gemini 2.5 Flash Image … Up to 3 images'); no video or audio input.
'Max size per input base64-encoded image 7 MB' (all image models).

Vertex AI limitations page words both caps as best-results advice: 'For best results using Gemini 3 Pro Image, include a maximum of 14 images in an input.' / 'For best results using Gemini 2.5 Flash Image, include a maximum of three images in an input.' The page covers only these two models.
Nano Banana 2 and Pro: 'You can mix up to 14 reference object images in a single prompt.'; '… can combine up to 14 input images (with up to 6 in high fidelity) into a unified composition.'

Gemini 3 image models let you mix up to 14 reference images to produce the final image; 'Maximum images per prompt: 14' on the Agent Platform cards of Gemini 3 Pro Image, Gemini 3.1 Flash Image and Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite Image.
Gemini 2.5 Flash Image: 'Maximum images per prompt: 3' (Agent Platform card); 'gemini-2.5-flash-image works best with up to 3 images as input' (Gemini API docs).

модели_различия.текст_en: Up to 14 input images per request.
Up to 14 input images per request.
Up to 14 input images per request (technical cap); the Get_Started cookbook says up to 3 (see contradiction).
Up to 3 input images per request; the Gemini API docs word it as works best with up to 3 images.

оговорки.текст_en: The Gemini cookbook gives Nano-Banana 2 Lite a cap of 3 images ('up to 3 with Nano-Banana 2 Lite'), while Firebase gives 14 per request for all 3.x models (see contradiction 1).
The same number 14 is presented both as a maximum ('Maximum images per prompt') and as 'for best results' advice on two Vertex AI pages.
For Gemini 2.5 Flash Image there is no split by role (objects/characters/style), only 'Up to 3 images'.
A PDF page counts as one image and uses the same budget (see the linked PDF input core).
Google products have their own caps ('varies by surface', Gemini app, Ads); see the linked core on product surfaces.
The split of these 14 by type (high-fidelity objects / characters / style) and by model is a separate linked core on reference slots.

The blog (2026-03-05) words it for NB2 and Pro as 'up to 14 reference object images in a single prompt'; per the docs table there are fewer high-fidelity objects (Pro 6, NB2 10), and 14 is the overall cap.
The Agent Platform models page ties 14 to character consistency for Pro: 'character consistency using up to 14 reference inputs' (see the dispute in the linked core on reference slots).
Limitations section of the docs: 'gemini-3-pro-image supports 5 images with high fidelity, and up to 14 images in total'.
The Vertex notebook for NB Pro says 'multiple reference images' without a number; its example uses 6 references.
Get_Started notebook: 'up to 14 with Nano-Banana 2 and Pro, 6 with high fidelity'.
Vertex notebooks for NB2 and Lite: 'you can include up to 14 reference images in a request to generate a new image that preserves the content of the original images'.
For Lite, consistency quality is optimal with up to 3 references (see the linked core on Lite and multiple references).
gemini-2.5-flash-image takes no more than 3 images.
The public HTTP URL channel on Agent Platform allows up to 10 images per request; this is a channel limit (see the linked core on passing media by URI).
The Gemini API docs word it softly, 'works best with up to 3 images as input' (a recommendation); the Agent Platform card states it as a hard maximum.
Agent Platform card (summary): up to 3 images and 3 documents of up to 3 pages each per prompt, a 32,768-token context, no thinking and no grounding.

приёмы.текст_en: If there are more images than the cap, first combine several images into one collage (see the linked collage core).
If you need more images than the upload limit allows, first combine them into one collage (see the linked collage core).

ядра.не_применяется_когда: Working in Google products (Gemini app, Google Ads, Workspace, Flow), which have their own caps; a request without input images.

Часть 1 решила по (в), часть 2 — по (б); у кукбука нет полной даты, поэтому решающее правило — (в). Косвенно 14 поддерживает карточка Lite (ранг 1, 2026-06-30): бенчмарк 'Multi Product (up to 14) Editing' (E-169-24). Цифра 3 из кукбука сохранена как расхождение; вопрос открыт.]

ядра.ядро_en: Gemini 3 image models split the reference budget by type (Gemini API table 'Use up to 14 reference images'): Gemini 3 Pro Image — up to 6 images of objects with high-fidelity to include in the final image, up to 5 images of characters to maintain character consistency, up to 3 images to be used as style references (overall it can blend as many as 14 inputs); Gemini 3.1 Flash Image — up to 10 images of objects with high-fidelity, up to 4 images of characters, style references N/A; Gemini 3.1 Flash Lite Image — up to 14 images of objects with high-fidelity, character images N/A, style references N/A.

части.текст_en: objects with high-fidelity: Pro 6 / Flash (NB2) 10 / Flash Lite 14
characters to maintain character consistency: Pro 5 / Flash (NB2) 4 / Flash Lite N/A
style references: Pro 3 / Flash (NB2) N/A / Flash Lite N/A
'Up to 6 images of objects with high-fidelity to include in the final image'; '… integrate six high-fidelity shots …'
'Up to 5 images of characters to maintain character consistency'; '… consistency and resemblance of up to 5 people'
'Up to 3 images to be used as style references'
'… or blend as many as fourteen standard inputs into a single, polished ad'; 'using up to 14 images'
API (Firebase AI Logic): 'Up to 10 images of objects with high-fidelity to include in the final image; Up to 4 images of characters to maintain character consistency'
Launch and model pages: 'Maintain character resemblance of up to five characters and the fidelity of up to 14 objects in a single workflow'
'(varies by product and surface)'
Gemini app: 'up to five characters and the fidelity of up to ten objects in a single workflow in the Gemini app'

модели_различия.текст_en: Up to 6 objects with high fidelity, up to 5 characters, up to 3 style references; up to 14 inputs in total.

Up to 10 objects with high fidelity and up to 4 characters through the API; no style-reference slot. Launch pages say up to five characters and 14 objects (varies by product and surface); the Gemini app says five characters and ten objects.
Up to 14 objects with high fidelity; character images N/A; style references N/A (Gemini API table). The Firebase docs list 10 objects and 4 characters (see contradiction).
No split by type: only up to 3 images in total.

оговорки.текст_en: The per-model sums add up to the overall cap of 14: Pro 6+5+3, NB2 10+4, Lite 14.

Limitations section of the same page: NB2 'supports character resemblance of up to 4 characters and the fidelity of up to 10 objects in a single workflow'; Pro 'supports 5 images with high fidelity, and up to 14 images in total'.
NB2 blog (2026-02-26): 'up to five characters and the fidelity of up to 14 objects (varies by product and surface)'; the numbers depend on the product or surface.
The pages do not say what 'high fidelity' means or how the model tells an object reference from a character or style reference; the examples have no separate reference-type parameter.
Lite: '14 objects with high-fidelity' diverges from 'Not optimized for multiple reference inputs'; the dispute is kept in the linked core on Lite and multiple references.

The developer blog gives three numbers in one sentence joined by 'or' ('five individuals … six high-fidelity shots, or … fourteen standard inputs'); the page does not define the difference between 'high-fidelity shots' and 'standard inputs'.
No page says whether the 6 + 5 + 3 slots count within the overall 14 or separately.
Firebase names the style references slot (up to 3) only for Pro; the NB2, Lite and 2.5 rows do not have it.

DeepMind showcase: 'Maintain the consistency and resemblance of up to five characters and the fidelity of up to fourteen objects in a single workflow'; what 'single workflow' means (one request or a session) is not explained.

The overall cap is 14 images per request (see the linked core on the input image cap). The cookbook for NB2 and Pro says 'up to 14 … (with up to 6 in high fidelity)', which diverges from the 10 objects in Firebase.
The Firebase table does not name a style references slot for NB2.

ядра.ядро_en: Nano Banana 2 (gemini-3.1-flash-image) is described as excelling at multiple reference image processing and consistency, while Nano Banana 2 Lite is not optimized for multiple reference inputs or multi-turn sequential editing; with Lite, consistency remains optimal when the number of input reference images is limited to 3.

части.текст_en: NB2: Excelling at multiple reference image processing and consistency
Lite: Not optimized for multiple reference inputs or multi-turn sequential editing
Lite: consistency remains optimal when the number of input reference images is limited to 3

оговорки.текст_en: 'Not optimized' is not a ban: Lite technically accepts up to 14 images (see the linked core on the input image cap).
Lite card: 'Maintains high character alignment matching original Nano Banana standards'; the level is set relative to the original Nano Banana.
Lite blog (2026-06-30): 'Maintain character identities and object fidelity across multiple swift generations', for storyboards and virtual try-on in e-commerce.
Get_Started notebook: for Lite 'up to 3' images when mixing.

приёмы.текст_en: If you use Lite and need consistency, keep to at most 3 references; for many references and step-by-step edits choose NB2 (or Pro).

ядра.не_применяется_когда: A single reference or text-only generation.
ядра.магнит_причина: Negation in the core: Lite is not optimized for multiple reference inputs or multi-turn sequential editing.

ядра.ядро_en: Input modalities of the image models: all Gemini Image models accept image and text input, and none of them accepts audio (image generation does not support audio inputs); Gemini 3.1 Flash Image and Gemini 3.1 Flash Lite Image accept text, image, video and PDF; the Gemini 3.x image models accept documents (PDFs or plain text), and Gemini 2.5 Flash Image takes up to 3 documents on Agent Platform. Video input is supported for Gemini 3.1 Flash Image and Gemini 3.1 Flash Lite Image — frames only, about 25 minutes and about 12 minutes of total input video respectively; video with audio (frames+audio) is not supported by the image models; whether Gemini 3 Pro Image accepts video is disputed between pages.

Вероятно различие поверхностей: Gemini API — нет, Agent Platform — да. Обе версии сохранены. | ч2: (г) Pro видео на вход не принимает. ядра.ядро_en: When media are passed by URI on Agent Platform: a Cloud Storage bucket URI must point to an object that is publicly readable or resides in the same Google Cloud project that's sending the request; an HTTP URL must be publicly readable, and you can specify one video file, one audio file, and up to 10 image files per request, with audio files, video files and documents not exceeding 15 MB; a YouTube video must be owned by the signed-in account or be public, and only one YouTube video URL is supported per request; when specifying a fileURI you must also specify its mimeType, and media file URLs are not supported when VPC Service Controls is enabled.

части.текст_en: Cloud Storage URI: publicly readable or same project
HTTP URL: publicly readable; 1 video, 1 audio, up to 10 images per request; audio/video/documents ≤ 15 MB
YouTube URL: public or owned by the signed-in account; one per request
fileURI requires mimeType; no media file URLs under VPC Service Controls

оговорки.текст_en: The cap of 10 images applies to the HTTP URL channel; the models accept up to 14 images (see the linked core on the input image cap). Whether 10 applies when channels are mixed is not said.
Console: import from Google Drive up to 10 MB in total and 7 MB per file; prompt data beyond the token limit is truncated.

версии.текст: For Gemini 3 Pro Image, input images cost 560 tokens per image. [E-88-43; 2026-09-22; ранг 1]
Gemini 3: variable length by media_resolution, default 1120 for images [E-88-65; 2026-09-22; ранг 1]

per the token table the default for images (1120 tokens) equals the HIGH level [E-133-76; 2026-09-22; ранг 1]

противоречия.решение: Разные модели: 560 — карточки Gemini 3 Pro Image (Agent Platform, Vertex, прайс Gemini API); 1120 — общий дефолт media_resolution для моделей Gemini 3, к image-моделям прямо не отнесён (у NB2 и Lite 1120 названо их карточками). Влияет ли media_resolution на Pro Image, страницы не говорят. Итог частей совпадает. [решения частей: ч1: (а) Для Pro Image действует число его карточки (560); 1120 — общий дефолт Gemini 3. Страница не объясняет, влияет ли media_resolution на Pro Image. | ч2: (а) Разные модели: 560 — карточка Gemini 3 Pro Image; 1120 — таблица media_resolution для моделей Gemini 3 (к image-моделям прямо не отнесена). Обе верны для своих моделей.]

ядра.ядро_en: media_resolution can be set in generationConfig to apply to all media in the request, or on individual media parts, which overrides the top-level setting; levels are low, medium, high and ultra_high, ultra_high can only be set for individual media parts, and if media_resolution is unspecified the model uses optimal defaults based on the media type.

оговорки.текст_en: media_resolution sets the maximum number of tokens per input image, PDF page or video frame.

The media_resolution pages talk about Gemini 3 and the API schema in general; the image models are not named there. Whether the parameter affects Nano Banana is not said (Pro Image input is fixed at 560 tokens, see the linked token core).
Interactions API: each ImageContent block has its own resolution field (low, medium, high, ultra_high).
Python SDK: media_resolution=types.PartMediaResolution(level=types.PartMediaResolutionLevel.MEDIA_RESOLUTION_HIGH) on a Part.

ядра.не_применяется_когда: No fine-tuning of input tokens is needed.

версии.текст: mediaResolution ... supported values are HIGH, MEDIUM and LOW (Agent Platform inference reference) [E-125-19; 2026-09-22; ранг 1]

противоречия.решение: Для Gemini 3 ULTRA_HIGH существует и ставится только на отдельную часть; список из трёх значений — без привязки к модели.

ядра.ядро_en: Use the media_resolution parameter to control the maximum number of tokens the model uses to represent an image or frames in videos: higher media_resolution improves the model's ability to read fine text or identify small details in inputs, but increases token usage and latency; lower resolution (LOW) reduces tokens per image or video, possibly losing detail, and optimizes cost and latency for images with less visual detail; if requests exceed the context window due to higher default resolutions (for example, very long inputs), explicitly reduce the media resolution.

оговорки.текст_en: Gemini 3 recommendations: ultra_high (up to 2240) for analyzing small details (screen recording frames, high-resolution photos); high (up to 1120) for analyzing images with maximum quality; medium (560) and low are named sufficient for most tasks (per the HTML the phrase sits in the low row).
Everything is said about input understanding by Gemini 3 models; applicability to the Nano Banana models is not confirmed.
The page covers Gemini 3 in general (code example on gemini-3.6-flash); it is not directly tied to the image models.
Gemini 3 tokenizes media with variable length instead of Pan and Scan; moving to the Gemini 3 defaults can increase tokens for images and PDFs and decrease them for video.
Extraction inference: the default for images (1120 tokens) equals HIGH, so without the parameter each input image costs as much as HIGH.

приёмы.текст_en: To fit very long inputs (a long video, a large document), lower media_resolution (for example, to LOW).
Python SDK: config=types.GenerateContentConfig(media_resolution=types.MediaResolution.MEDIA_RESOLUTION_LOW).

ядра.ситуация_в_промпте: A reference contains small text or a detail that must be kept exactly, or, conversely, there are many inputs and tokens need to be saved.
ядра.не_применяется_когда: The parameter is not set, or the model counts input at a fixed rate (Pro Image).

ядра.ядро_en: Images are passed as input parts alongside the text in the same request content: inline as base64-encoded data with its media type (mimeType must also be specified), or as data stored in a file referenced by URI (fileData / Part.from_uri: Cloud Storage, HTTP URL, Files API).

модели_различия.текст_en: applies to: gemini-2.0-flash (in the curl example)

оговорки.текст_en: A Part contains exactly one data type; raw bytes in inlineData need a fixed IANA MIME type; text is not sent as bytes.
A message is an ordered list of parts, and parts can have different MIME types.
One request can mix an image from Cloud Storage (Part.from_uri) and a local image as bytes (Part.from_bytes).

Interactions API: an image is an ImageContent block {type: "image", data | uri, mime_type, resolution}; the same block appears in user input, model responses, tool results and thought summaries; the input can be a list of Content.
Summary of Agent Platform channels: inline base64 + mimeType (up to 7 MB), Cloud Storage URI (public or in the same project), public HTTP URL (up to 10 images).
The pages the SDK code examples come from show input for image understanding (text answer), not for generation.

ядра.ядро_en: Reference images are addressed in prompts either by their content — deictically or possessively ('this plant', 'this scene', 'these images', 'these people', 'the character', 'this man', 'this logo', 'the subject in this image', 'my cat') — or by their position in the input ('the first image', 'the second image', 'image 1 / image 2'), with the input-part order matching the ordinal words; the input can also be labeled in an opening sentence ('This is a photo of me and my dog.'), and the subject's appearance is left to the image instead of being re-described.

оговорки.текст_en: NB Pro notebook: each reference is named by its content and related to the others through spatial relations; there are no ordinal references ('first image') anywhere.
2.5 notebooks: references are named by their content with demonstratives ('this dog', 'this living room', 'the girl', 'this t-shirt'), not by index.
Get_Started notebook: references are named collectively ('these two images', 'these items', 'this image', 'the picture'), without numbers.

In the 2.5 recipes notebook, inputs are named by role or position ('the second image', 'the person in the first image', 'empty bedroom as base', 'the product in this image'); ordinal references appear only in the try-on recipe.
An edit is phrased as a creation request or a conversational question, and the input is named possessively ('my cat', 'this picture of mine'); an observation from two examples.
This is not stated as a rule; it is an observation from examples.
The Pro showcase has no reference numbering scheme; roles are sometimes assigned (shape from a sketch, color from another image).
In the cookbook, references to inputs ('the first/second image', 'previous reference images') match the order of the request parts.

In the Halloween photo prompts the subject is 'this person', 'me' or a pet by name ('my cat, Sunny'); there is only one preservation clause ('Maintain existing pose and framing'), and the face is never mentioned.

приёмы.текст_en: Recipe prompts with references often end with a naturalness or quality requirement: 'look natural and blend seamlessly', 'to make it look natural', 'should look like a high-end advertisement'.
Say in the first sentence what the inputs are: 'This is a photo of my younger self and a photo of myself today.' / 'Here's a picture of me as an adult.'

ядра.ядро_en: Explicitly reference the input images in the prompt ('Image 1: …', 'Image 2: …'): without them, 'the robot' could refer to any of the robots in the input images; with them, the model knows it is the same robot. To prevent confusion (or if the model gets confused), be more specific with 'the [entity] from image [number]'.

оговорки.текст_en: The notebook calls these references 'important'; the numbering follows the order of the input images: contents = [*sources, prompt].

Image understanding page: 'If your prompt contains multiple images, and you want to refer to them later in your prompt or have the model refer to them in the model response, it can help to give each image an index before the image'; labels a, b, c or image 1, image 2, image 3 are placed as a separate part before the image.

A second method on the same page (understanding): a caption right after each image in a few-shot sequence sets the answer format ("city: …, Landmark: …"), and the parts alternate: image 1, text 1, image 2, text 2, image 3.

приёмы.текст_en: Clarification template: 'the [entity] from image [number]'.

ядра.ситуация_в_промпте: The input has several images with similar entities (two views of a character and a previous scene), and the text must say unambiguously which one is meant.
ядра.не_применяется_когда: There is one reference, or the references are clearly different and cannot be confused.
ядра.магнит_причина: Negation and a concrete object in the core: without labels 'the robot' could refer to any robot.

ядра.ядро_en: Scene prompts in the consistent-imagery notebook are a bulleted list that first declares each input image's role ('- Image 1: Reference robot character sheet.', '- Image 2: Previous scene.'), then labeled sections as needed — Scene (shot type/genre), Setting/Background, Foreground/Composition (placement in frame + viewing angle), Action & Details, Lighting, View, Text.

оговорки.текст_en: The sections are optional: some scenes are written as free-form bullets after Image 1/2.
In the climbing scene Image 2 is labeled 'Previous scene', although per the code it is the original mountain scene; the role label is inaccurate.

приёмы.текст_en: First scene: the input's role ('Image 1: Reference robot character sheet') → Scene (shot genre + world) → Background → Foreground (character placement and angle) → Lighting.
Next scenes: roles of Image 1 and Image 2 → story transition → position and angle → new prop with its material → environment → changed lighting.
The form can be imperative (Remove / Move / Suspend / Place / Maintain) or descriptive (the character's state + a replacing object).

примеры.текст:
- Image 1: Reference robot character sheet.
- Scene: Macro photography of a beautifully crafted miniature diorama.
- Background: Soft focus on an infinite panoramic range of interspersed, dome-like smooth-felt mountains, in random shades of medium blue/green, all with curvy white snowcaps, extending over the entire horizon.
- Foreground: On the bottom left, the robot stands on the edge of a medium-gray felt cliff, captured from a 3/4 rear view, looking out over a sea of clouds (made of white cotton).
- Lighting: Studio, warm, clean and soft.
примеры.что_показывает_en: First-scene structured prompt: Image 1 role, scene as macro photography of a felt diorama, background, foreground with character placement and view, lighting.

примеры.текст:
- Image 1: Reference robot character sheet.
- Image 2: Previous scene.
- The robot has descended from the cliff into a gray felt valley. It stands in the center, seen directly from the back. It is holding/reading a felt map.
- Large, smooth, round felt rocks in various beige/gray shades are visible on the sides.
- Background: The distant infinite panoramic mountain range extending over the entire horizon. A thin layer of clouds obscures its base and the end of the valley.
- Lighting: Golden hour light, soft and diffused.
примеры.что_показывает_en: Successive-scene prompt (valley): roles of Image 1 and Image 2, then new placement, view, prop, surroundings, background and a changed lighting.

примеры.текст:
- Image 1: Reference robot character sheet.
- Image 2: Previous scene.
- The robot continues its journey through the valley and faces a dense wall of giant, thin trees hiding the entire background.
- The trees are made of light/medium/dark green felt.
- The robot is on the right, seen from a 3/4 rear angle, looking up at the trees. It is no longer holding the map. Instead, its arms are raised beside its ears.
- In the bottom-left and bottom-right corners, rocks (similar to Image 2) are partially visible.
примеры.что_показывает_en: Successive-scene prompt (forest): story progression, material of new elements, character position/view/pose, explicit removal of the map, and continuity of rocks with Image 2.

примеры.текст:
- Image 1: Reference robot character sheet.
- Image 2: Previous scene.
- The robot walks through the dense forest and emerges into a clearing, making its way between two trees.
- The robot is in the center, now seen from the front.
- The ground is made of green felt, with flat patches of white felt snow. Rocks are no longer visible.
примеры.что_показывает_en: Successive-scene prompt (clearing): movement through the scene, new view, new ground material and explicit disappearance of rocks.

примеры.текст:
- Image 1: Reference robot character sheet.
- Image 2: Previous scene.
- Scene: A medium-wide shot of the robot climbing a broad, dome-shaped, medium-green mountain.
- Composition: The mountain is centered, with the robot on the left slope shown from a 3/4 rear angle.
- Action & Details: The robot has both feet on the mountain and uses two miniature ice picks (felt, with brown handles and gray heads) to reach the summit, planting them into the bottom part of the white felt snowcap.
- Background: The distant mountain range spans the entire horizon.
примеры.что_показывает_en: Structured scene prompt (ascension) with labeled Scene, Composition, Action & Details and Background sections.

примеры.текст:
- Image 1: Reference robot character sheet.
- Image 2: Previous scene.
- The robot reaches the top and stands on the summit, seen from the front.
- It is no longer holding the ice picks, which are planted upright in the snow on either side.
- It has both arms raised as a sign of victory. Its face and hands are unchanged.
примеры.что_показывает_en: Successive-scene prompt (summit): reaching the top, new view, props planted in the snow, victory pose, and an explicit 'unchanged' constraint for face and hands.

примеры.текст:
- Image 1: Reference robot character sheet.
- Image 2: Previous scene.
- Remove the ice picks.
- Move the center mountain to the left edge of the image and add a slightly taller medium-blue mountain to the right edge.
- Suspend a stylized felt bridge between the two mountains: its deck is made of stylized thick planks of plain felt in various wood shades.
- Place the robot in the center of the bridge with one arm pointing toward the blue mountain.
- Maintain the background.
- View: Close-up.
примеры.что_показывает_en: Imperative recomposition prompt (bridge): remove props, move and add mountains, suspend a felt bridge, place the character with a gesture, maintain background, set close-up view.

примеры.текст:
- Image 1: Reference robot character sheet.
- Image 2: Previous scene.
- The robot is sleeping peacefully in a comfortable brown-and-tan tartan hammock that has replaced the bridge.
- Both of the robot's eyes are closed, in a "sleeping" state.

ядра.ядро_en: Multi-image fusion: provide multiple images as context to create a new, composite scene — the model can identify objects and concepts from different inputs, understand them and merge them into a single, coherent image; suited to product mockups or creative collages, putting an object into a scene, restyling a room with a color scheme or texture, and fusing images with a single prompt.

оговорки.текст_en: Gemini 2.5 Flash Image: image-to-image from several references is useful for character consistency, logos, style transfer, inserting and removing objects; you can ask for accompanying text.
Agent Platform recommends Gemini Image (not Imagen) for 'Combine creative elements from multiple images with a single prompt'.
Generation from several references appeared in the Gemini 2.5 Flash Image preview (2025-08-26) and remained in GA (2025-10-02); the number of references is not named there.
2.5 blog (2025-08): multi-image fusion combines different images into one seamless visual for marketing, education and advertising.
Hackathon (2025-09): 'consistency, fusion and editing' are advanced API features; the apps rely on editing and multi-input rather than pure text-to-image.
Most of these pages do not state how many images can be blended; the caps are in the linked limit cores.
android.com: 'Enhanced blending capabilities, allowing for more images to be uploaded at the same time without loss in terms of consistency' (no number given).
Google itself counts blending several images among risky operations (artifacts, 'disjointed scenes'); see the linked artifacts core.
A group photo from separate shots with adjusted lighting, perspective and shadows is a description of a hackathon participant's project, not a Google recommendation.

приёмы.текст_en: Multiple references for character consistency or for placing a specific product into a new environment: 'Gemini allows you to combine multiple reference images to guide the final output.'
Cookbook: request parts *ref_images, canvas, text; the model 'can identify objects and concepts from different inputs and merge them'.
Yourself with your pet in one shot, a new room background to try out wallpaper, yourself anywhere, 'all while keeping you, you'.
A selfie plus a famous painting: 'combine the two photos into one scene'.
Collection of reference images guides generation; the model combines elements and styles from multiple sources into a cohesive new scene.

оговорки.текст_en: The template addresses references by ordinal numbers; many official multi-reference examples name them by content or collectively (see the linked addressing core).
The template is given for Gemini 2.5 Flash Image; references are addressed by order ('first image', 'second image').
Firebase shows the same scheme with addressing by content: '[image of a cat] + [image of a pillow] + Create a cross stitch of my cat on this pillow.'

приёмы.текст_en: To add an object: 'Upload a base image and an object image, and tell the model to combine them.'
The genre of the result first, then the element from reference 1 with its features, the element from reference 2, and finally how to integrate it (lighting and shadows matched to the environment).
Name each item from the references with a distinguishing feature (color, cut) so that it maps unambiguously to one reference (six references in one prompt).
First ask the model to list the elements of all references, then combine them; declare one reference as the base and say what to keep from it (the camera angle).
With many references, they are named collectively: 'these people', 'these items', 'everything in these images', 'the style and elements of these two images'.
Adding elements: Upload a base image and an object image, and tell the model to combine them.
After the transfer, match the lighting and shadows to the environment ('with the lighting and shadows adjusted to match an outdoor environment').

What may change: 'their expressions and angles should vary'
Against duplicates: 'Make sure to only have one of each character in each image.'
References via 'these/this' with a number: 'these 14 characters and items', 'these 3 fluffy friends'
In edits of people, a separate sentence about the face: 'Don't change the faces.', 'Mimic my real face.', 'Keep his face the same.', 'Keep my face exactly as it is.'

The photography style is highly detailed and almost macro, showcasing the exquisite craftsmanship of the subject. The camera angle is slightly elevated, looking down upon the insect and the surrounding elements, creating a sense of intimacy and wonder. The dominant colors are soft whites, creams, and light blues, with striking accents of gold, silver, and vibrant teal and orange on the insect's body. The lighting is soft and diffused, highlighting the translucent quality of the insect's wings and the gentle textures of the flowers. There's a subtle glow that suggests either natural daylight or a carefully placed artificial light source, creating gentle shadows that add depth. The main subject is the elaborate mechanical insect, which features translucent, veined wings with delicate gold and silver filigree patterns and embedded jewels. Its body is a mosaic of tiny gears, polished metal, and sparkling gemstones, with a segment of its abdomen adorned in bright teal and orange enamel. Its delicate, jointed legs are made of polished silver and clear glass-like tubes, and it has fine antennae extending from its head. The insect is resting on a cluster of soft, white, organic-looking forms, some resembling unfurling petals or intricate lace. In the blurred background, out-of-focus white flowers with subtle yellow or red centers add to the dreamy, serene atmosphere. The overall impression is one of delicate beauty, precision engineering, and a blend of natural and artificial elegance.

ядра.подтема: консистентность: один субъект в разных сценах
ядра.ядро_en: Character and style consistency: the model can maintain the same subject or visual style across multiple generations and reuse the same characters while altering their outfits, poses, lighting or the entire scene, or even render them from different angles, all while preserving their likeness — keeping a person, pet, character or product recognizable across generations and edits without losing their identity, saving you from time-consuming fine-tuning.

оговорки.текст_en: Google's criterion: 'A depiction that's close but not quite the same can feel off'; a small deviation in a face is perceived as a failure.
Consistency is not guaranteed; see the linked core on consistency limits.
The words of WPP, Freepik and Leonardo.ai come from partners, not Google.
When editing, the model analyzes the style, lighting and perspective of the original so that the edit looks natural and the character is preserved across the series.
It holds without fine-tuning: 'saving you from time-consuming fine-tuning'.
Facial features, distinctive look and clothing are preserved.

Partner quotes (WPP, Freepik, Leonardo.ai) are not Google's words: combining several products in a shot, object consistency across shots, product placement, style alignment and character consistency 'in a single step'.
Consistency holds at different levels: character, scene, texture, lighting, angle or camera type.
The codelab describes consistency through prompts and image assets and does not mention fine-tuning (an inference from silence).

приёмы.текст_en: Build the edit as 'keep the subject, change the context': the person or product stays recognizable, and only the place, background or outfit changes.
Nano Banana 2 is for personal images: yourself with a different hairstyle, in other scenes, memes.

ядра.ситуация_в_промпте: I need a series of images with the same person, pet or product in different outfits, poses, places and angles.
ядра.не_применяется_когда: Guaranteed identity in every shot without checking is required; Google admits that consistency does not always succeed.

ядра.ядро_en: Maintaining character consistency across multiple images is a common challenge: use a reference image of the character to generate new scenes with the same character in different contexts; through separate API calls, pass the reference image of the character (plus a blank canvas for the aspect ratio) and a new scene description in each call — the cookbook adds the text part 'Use previous reference images of the character to generate the new scene' and phrases each scene as 'The character is …'.

оговорки.текст_en: A recipe for gemini-2.5-flash-image-preview; each scene is a separate independent call with the same reference (not a chat).
The prompt is assembled from several text parts: parts=[image_part, canvas, 'Use previous reference images…', user_idea, 'make sure to use canvas for aspect ratio'].

приёмы.текст_en: The recipe request is assembled from parts: the character reference, a 9:16 canvas, 'Use previous reference images of the character to generate the new scene', the scene idea ('The character is …'), 'make sure to use canvas for aspect ratio'.

The subject in the photo is named by its content and the new scene or style is described: 'my cat', 'this dog', 'the person in this image', 'the characters in the picture', 'Using the image of the cat'.
Call the subject 'The character' without describing its appearance; then its role, action and place.

Text can be added to the output (captions on the character sheet) and the text in the inputs can be referred to (front/back view labels); the notebook has no prompt that actually refers to these labels.

- Right Side: Straight-on back view of the robot wearing the same backpack. The backpack's flap is secured by a tiny, matte-brass, rounded-square ring buckle. The back of the robot's head must be completely seamless.
- Text: Small sans-serif text. Centered at the top, a caption "ROBOT CHARACTER SHEET". At the bottom, label the left side "FRONT VIEW" and the right side "BACK VIEW".

ядра.ядро_en: Each successive prompt states only what changes — placement, view, pose, added or removed props, new materials — and relies on the references for everything unspecified; when only some elements are changed and no further details are given, the model will generally preserve most of the others; anything that should disappear must be stated explicitly (e.g., 'no longer holding the map').

оговорки.текст_en: 'generally' and 'most' are not a guarantee.
You can change the character's position and point of view and even 'animate' the hands for expressiveness.

приёмы.текст_en: Remove props that are no longer there explicitly: the instruction 'no longer holding the map' keeps the model from carrying them over awkwardly from the previous scene (for example, dropping them on the ground).

- In the bottom-left and bottom-right corners, rocks (similar to Image 2) are partially visible.

ядра.ядро_en: Imagen 3 Customization offers free-style prompting, which can give the impression that it can do more than it is trained to do; use it for the intended use cases (e.g., stylize a photo of a person, optionally preserving facial expression; generate variations of a product that don't preserve exact details; place a product into different scenes with different angles — low success), because unintended use cases produce poor results: placing or stylizing two or more people while preserving their identities (also with a style example image), placing a pet into different scenes or stylizing a pet photo into a drawing, placing a pet with a person, placing two products into different scenes with different angles, placing a product into different scenes with a specific image style, and placing products while preserving a scene composition from a control image.

части.текст_en: intended: stylize a person photo (optionally preserving facial expression)
intended: product variations without exact details
intended but low success: product in different scenes and angles
unintended: two or more people with preserved identities
unintended: pets in scenes / pet stylization / pet with people
unintended: two products at different angles; product with a specific image style; products with composition from a control image

оговорки.текст_en: «while you can push the model to do things outside of the intended use cases, we don't expect good results».
The boundary between intended E-85-7 and unintended E-85-13 is whether a specific image style is set.

ядра.ядро_en: To use Imagen 3 Customization, include the referenceId of the reference image or images you provide in the format [$referenceId]; reference images of the same subject (or style) share the same referenceId, and a control face mesh image has a distinct referenceId.

оговорки.текст_en: Console: all images added in one Add reference panel get one number, which is the number written in the prompt.

REST: referenceImages with REFERENCE_TYPE_SUBJECT (subjectImageConfig: SUBJECT_TYPE_PERSON / SUBJECT_TYPE_PRODUCT) and REFERENCE_TYPE_CONTROL (controlImageConfig: CONTROL_TYPE_FACE_MESH, enableControlImageComputation true).
SUBJECT_DESCRIPTION is an optional text description of the reference that is then used in the prompt field.

приёмы.текст_en: The tag [n] is placed right after the noun phrase describing the subject (or style), and the same text is used as subjectDescription (for example, 'Luxe Elixir hair oil, golden liquid in glass bottle [1]').

примеры.текст: "subjectDescription": "Luxe Elixir hair oil, golden liquid in glass bottle"
примеры.что_показывает_en: REST product example of subjectDescription reuse: prompt 'Luxe Elixir hair oil, golden liquid in glass bottle [1] against a pure white background.' with the same subjectDescription text.

ядра.ядро_en: Recommended starting-point templates for Imagen 3 Customization: 'Generate an image of SUBJECT_DESCRIPTION [1] with the facemesh from the control image [2]. ${PROMPT}'; 'Create an image about SUBJECT_DESCRIPTION [1] to match the description: a portrait of SUBJECT_DESCRIPTION [1]${PROMPT}'; 'Create a STYLE_DESCRIPTION [2] image about SUBJECT_DESCRIPTION [1] to match the description: a portrait of SUBJECT_DESCRIPTION [1]STYLE_PROMPT'; 'Create an image about SUBJECT_DESCRIPTION [1] in the pose of the CONTROL_IMAGE [2] to match the description: a portrait of SUBJECT_DESCRIPTION [1]${PROMPT}'; 'Create a STYLE_DESCRIPTION [3] image about SUBJECT_DESCRIPTION [1] in the pose of the CONTROL_IMAGE [2] to match the description: a portrait of SUBJECT_DESCRIPTION [1]${PROMPT}'; product: 'Create an image about SUBJECT_DESCRIPTION [1] to match the description: ${PROMPT}'; product variations: 'Generate an image of a SUBJECT_DESCRIPTION but ${PROMPT}'.

части.текст_en: person + face mesh
person without face mesh (1-4 subject images)
person + style tag [2]
person + pose from control image [2]
person + style [3] + pose [2]
product (1-4 subject images)
product variation ('but ...')

оговорки.текст_en: All templates follow one skeleton: '<Create|Generate> [a STYLE [n]] image about SUBJECT_DESCRIPTION [1] [in the pose of the control image [2]] to match the description: <a description repeating SUBJECT_DESCRIPTION [1]>'; the tagged subject description appears twice.

There are templates with a style tag ([2]/[3]), but their Reference images column lists only subject/face mesh; a style reference in this mode is not described (while the console example uses 'film noir style [2]').
The references in the page examples were themselves generated by Imagen 3 (the prompts for the person and product references are given).
The face example with a face mesh is cut off on the page with '...'.

приёмы.текст_en: Style, shot type, background and a comma-separated list of descriptors are added to the template; for a product variation, one attribute change via 'but' ('... [1] but in blue').

Imagen 1 fine-tuning: a subject with a text identifier and 4 to 8 images per subject, billed per node hour.
imagen-4.0-ingredients-preview was withdrawn; the recommended migration endpoint is gemini-2.5-flash-image (2026-02-17).
Instant ID (an identity-preserving generation model) was added to Model Garden on 2024-05-20.

ядра.ядро_en: Limitations of image understanding: content moderation, spatial reasoning, medical uses, people recognition, accuracy on low-quality images, handwritten text.

части.текст_en: Content moderation: The models refuse to provide answers on images that violate our safety policies. (E-88-56, outside the input)
Spatial reasoning: The models aren't precise at locating text or objects in images. They might only return the approximated counts of objects. (E-88-57)
Medical uses: The models aren't suitable for interpreting medical images (for example, x-rays and CT scans) or providing medical advice. (E-88-58)
People recognition: The models aren't meant to be used to identify people who aren't celebrities in images. (E-88-59, outside the input)
Accuracy: The models might hallucinate or make mistakes when interpreting low-quality, rotated, or extremely low-resolution images. (E-88-60, outside the input)
The models might also hallucinate when interpreting handwritten text in images documents. (E-88-61; the source omits 'and')

ядра.не_применяется_когда: generating a new image without analyzing the input
ядра.магнит_причина: Negations in the core: the models aren't precise, aren't suitable, aren't meant to identify people.

вопросы.текст: Lite через API: потолок 14 картинок (Firebase, 2026-09-24) или 3 (кукбук, ©2026)? Принято 14 по дате; нужна сверка по свежей странице модели или живым вызовом (E-229-22, E-326-34).
вопросы.чем_снят: Сшивка с частью 1: 14 для Lite дают источники ранга 1 — карточка Lite на Agent Platform («Maximum images per prompt: 14», E-51-25) и доки Gemini API (E-1-45, E-1-47), а также ноутбук Vertex (E-77-18); «up to 3» кукбука — практический оптимум консистентности (E-77-19). Решено по (в) в ядре Я-рефы-1.

вопросы.текст: Nano Banana 2 через API: 10 объектов + 4 персонажа (Firebase) или 5 персонажей + 14 объектов (анонсы, витрина DeepMind), или 14 всего с 6 в высокой точности (кукбук)? Строки NB2 и Lite в Firebase совпадают дословно — возможна копия (E-227-32, E-227-33, E-144-9, E-326-56).
вопросы.чем_снят: Сшивка с частью 1: для API таблица и раздел Limitations доков Gemini API (ранг 1: E-1-49, E-1-51, E-1-159 — 10 объектов и 4 персонажа) совпадают с Firebase; 5/14 — анонсы с оговоркой «varies by product and surface», Gemini app — продукт (ж). Решено по (б) в ядре Я-рефы-2. Возможная копия строки Lite в Firebase — отдельный вопрос сшивки.

вопросы.текст: Что значит 'single workflow' в пределах 5 персонажей / 14 объектов — один запрос или вся сессия (E-135-48, E-144-9, E-165-31)? [сшивка: часть 1 даёт ту же формулировку в разделе Limitations доков Gemini API (E-1-159: «… in a single workflow») — определения нет.]

Входят ли ролевые слоты Pro (6 объектов + 5 персонажей + 3 стиля) в общие 14 или считаются отдельно (E-227-29…31)? [сшивка: в части 1 есть только наблюдение агента, что суммы по моделям сходятся к 14 (Pro 6+5+3, E-1-53); прямого утверждения Google нет.]

Правило «формат кадра берётся с последней картинки» (E-163-52) сказано для 2.5 Flash Image; действует ли оно для 3.x-моделей — в этой части нет. [сшивка: частично — правило «формат последней входной картинки» есть в ноутбуке на Lite (E-79-24), а справочник Gemini API без привязки к модели говорит «based on any reference images provided» (E-19-45), ядро Я-рефы-84; для Pro и NB2 прямо не сказано.]
Примеры с '14 characters' (E-139-21, E-165-35) при лимите 4–5 персонажей: считает ли Google войлочных персонажей объектами? Страницы не уточняют.
Style references (до 3) названы только для Pro; принимают ли NB2/Lite/2.5 картинки стиля отдельным слотом — не сказано.
вопросы.чем_снят: Сшивка с частью 1: таблица доков Gemini API прямо ставит style references «N/A» для Gemini 3.1 Flash Image и Flash Lite Image (E-1-53); у 2.5 разбивки по типам нет (E-227-34). Ядро Я-рефы-2.

вопросы.текст: Страница ограничений Vertex (E-345-5/6) даёт 14 и 3 как 'for best results' — это жёсткий потолок API или совет? Карточка Vertex (E-261-20) называет 14 максимумом. [сшивка: часть 1 добавляет карточки Agent Platform всех четырёх моделей со строкой «Maximum images per prompt» (E-42-26, E-50-26, E-51-25, E-52-27) и доки Gemini API («at most 14»; для 2.5 — «works best with up to 3», E-1-157): для 3.x на большинстве страниц это максимум; для 2.5 формулировки расходятся.]

Пересмотр по (б) при сшивке: документы/PDF у Pro и у 2.5 приняты «да», потому что Firebase (2026-09-24) и карточка Agent Platform 2.5 (2026-09-22) новее карточек Gemini API (2026-09-03, «Image and Text»). Разница — штампы «Last updated» в 19–21 день; ТЗ исключает только штампы с разницей в день-два. Подтвердить, что такие штампы считаются датой для (б), или проверить живым вызовом (Я-рефы-10).

Строка Lite в таблице Firebase (E-227-33: 10 объектов, 4 персонажа) дословно совпадает со строкой NB2 (E-227-32) и расходится с таблицей Gemini API (Lite: 14 объектов, персонажи N/A). По (в) принята таблица Gemini API (Я-рефы-2); проверить по свежей странице Firebase, не ошибка ли копирования.
Связи из другое.json в «связи_с_другими_темами» не имели типа; при сшивке поставлен нейтральный «уточняет». Подтвердить или уточнить тип на шаге 3.

споры.суть: Принимает ли Gemini 3 Pro Image видео на входе

версии.текст: [Принимает ли Gemini 3 Pro Image видео на входе] This feature is only available for the Gemini 3.1 Flash Image and Gemini 3.1 Flash Lite Image models. (Gemini API) [E-1-70; 2026-09-23; ранг 1]
[Принимает ли Gemini 3 Pro Image видео на входе] video inputs are only supported for Gemini 3.1 Flash Image and Gemini 3.1 Flash Lite Image [E-1-155; 2026-09-23; ранг 1]
[Принимает ли Gemini 3 Pro Image видео на входе] gemini-3-pro-image Inputs: Image and Text (карточка Gemini API) [E-2-6; 2026-09-03; ранг 1]

[Принимает ли Gemini 3 Pro Image видео на входе] The following Gemini models support image generation from a video: gemini-3.1-flash-lite-image, gemini-3.1-flash-image, gemini-3-pro-image (Agent Platform) [E-87-3; 2026-09-22; ранг 1]
[Принимает ли Gemini 3 Pro Image видео на входе] Image generation, Image generation from video input — Supported [E-261-11; 2026-09-22; ранг 1]
[Принимает ли Gemini 3 Pro Image видео на входе] Input types > Video: Pro Image — нет; Flash Image, Flash-Lite Image — да [E-229-9; 2026-09-24; ранг 4]
[Принимает ли Gemini 3 Pro Image видео на входе] Image generation doesn't support audio or video inputs. [E-345-3; 2026-09-22; ранг 1]
[Принимает ли Gemini 3 Pro Image видео на входе] Modalities: Video — Not supported (та же карточка Vertex; единица вне этой части) [E-261-4; 2026-09-22; ранг 1]

сводка:
Тема «рефы»: на входе 142 ядра (ч1 — 68, ч2 — 68, из другое.json — 6), на выходе 116; слито 22 записей из 48 старых кодов.
Слились дубли частей, описывающие одно и то же с разных страниц: потолок 14/3 картинок, слоты по типам, MIME-типы, размер файлов, токены на картинку, media_resolution, модальности входа (видео/PDF/аудио), video-to-image, адресация рефов, формула [Reference images] + [Relationship instruction] + [New scenario], шаблон объединения элементов, слияние картинок, перенос стиля, консистентность, коллаж, холст для формата, перенос товара, примерка, Image Search, кадры для Veo, метка на входной картинке.
Продукт и API не сливались (ж): Lite в Gemini app и Firebase (Я-рефы-4) оставлено отдельно от ядра Lite в API (Я-рефы-3), связаны; правило «формат последней картинки» в API (Lite) и в промпте (2.5) оставлено двумя ядрами из-за разной применимости.
Пересмотрено по новым данным слияния: персонажи Pro — 5 (г, был спор); документы/PDF у Pro и у 2.5 — «да» по (б) (Firebase и Agent Platform новее карточек Gemini API). Спор остаётся: Я-рефы-3, Я-рефы-10 (Lite и много рефов — ч1; видео на входе у Pro — обе части и «другое»).
Классы описаний возможностей из ч1 переведены в «возможность_модели» (вопрос ч1). Модель E-80-51 — не_указано по правилу ТЗ (ч1 ставила nb25).
Переведено на английский 708 уникальных строк (оговорки, приёмы, ситуации, термины, словарь); ссылки на коды ядер в английских текстах заменены описанием, а сами связи добавлены в «связи» (11 шт.).
Вопросы: 23, снято сшивкой 7; вопрос о видео у Pro (ч1, ч2, «другое» №5) слит в один и не снят — нужен живой вызов на Agent Platform.
Сомнение: даты-штампы «Last updated» с разницей 19–21 день использованы как даты для (б) — вынесено в вопросы сшивки.
